title: Woman Standing on Balcony, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-century snapshot featuring a smiling woman in a light-colored sleeveless dress standing on an upper balcony or exterior walkway of an apartment building. The architectural setting includes decorative wrought-iron railings, tiled flooring, and mid-century window treatments. The print features scalloped (deckled) edges characteristic of snapshot prints from the late 1940s to 1950s.
